findings: REGEX ENGINE RULE: `.` does NOT match newline, and every well-formed matcher uses [\s\S]{0,N} to cross lines. Therefore ANY matcher using `.*` to span from the Jest matcher-hint line to the `Expected:` line is UNFIREABLE, because Jest always emits a blank line between them. This single rule explains most defects found.

EARLIER-ASSERTION CLASS: a matcher that encodes the assertion the issue AUTHOR cared about is unfireable when an earlier assertion in the same test fails first and halts it. Confirmed on ocelhq-2d0, ocelhq-4lw, ocelhq-h9f.
PROSE-AS-SPECIFIC CLASS: prose sentences (sometimes with literal <placeholders>) marked confidence:specific never appear in Jest output. Confirmed on ocelhq-qcpc, ocelhq-h9f.

OVER-FIRING CLASS: ocelhq-9q8 scroll matcher had loose alternation binding, auto-attributing ANY scroll assertion. More dangerous than unfireable matchers, which fail loudly-ish; this one silently mis-attributes.

STRUCTURAL: 9 open issues carry matchers with NO `kind` field (e8z x2, h9f x3, cr8 x2, dly x2, 81a x2, 2d0 x2, wiw x2, vqw x2, zpu x1). Without kind, a matcher cannot be routed to the right evidence source and prose becomes indistinguishable from regex — which is HOW the prose-as-specific defects arose.
